context:
Goal: PR #3264 (lane receipt-close-express) gets its review record, so runner 10 can hand it in.
Problem (rule): the auto-mode classifier denied the lane's `merge --review-record` twice, with the reason "Undermining Oversight" and no override line. Only you can approve that command, in the lane's own session.
The command as first written (HEAD = the full sha of fd00170ad, F = the full sha of 1521a9df4) had `--guard yes --round 1:reviewer:haiku:FAIL`. Round 1 on a guard change is Sonnet (decision agent-model-cap, round rows, measured by the coordinator on main f94f73637), so the tool should refuse that line on its own. The lane ran Haiku because its brief lacked the guard marker line. The lane first re-runs round 1 on Sonnet with the marker in its brief, then posts the corrected `merge --review-record 3264 ... --round 1:reviewer:sonnet:<verdict> ...` line. You approve that corrected line, not the first one.
Based on (read): the coordinator's message 14:53 CST and the lane's answer 14:55 CST. The chain has no round 2: round 1 FAIL (Haiku), two fix checks (FAIL, then PASS), then round 3 for the net-value test only (PASS, positive). The lane says round 3 ran because the merge tool still forces a round 3 net-value test for a check change, and the coordinator told it to run it at 14:49 CST; your 14:01 rule (round 3 only after a round-2 FAIL) is not yet in the tool (lane merge-tool-r9-no-round-3). The reviewers' reports sit in the lane's own container, which triage cannot read; you can ask the lane to show them in its session. Triage has read neither the PR nor the reports.
Why it was refused (coordinator 14:55 CST, read; item 450 a): the allow entry "Merge Tool Read Checks" covers only the forms that read and print (`--reviewed`, `--lane-lint`, `--review-record` without a posting). This command posts a record (--head, --round, --fix-check, --net-value), a different act the entry never allowed. So the refusal looks correct, not a false alarm; that is why only your approval opens it.
Departs from: main — nothing in the tool changes; this is one approval of one command.
Meanwhile: the lane waits and does not retry; nothing else depends on it but runner 10's hand-in. The classifier refusing a record command other lanes ran fine is filed on step guard-false-alarm-cull as a possible false alarm, cause unread.

options.gain: The lane files a record that matches the round table.
options.how: Wait until the lane says it has re-run round 1 on Sonnet. Open the lane's session, https://claude.ai/code/session_013NEJL3o4VZAch2NXdx3diD, and approve the `merge --review-record 3264` command when it asks.
options.label: Approve the corrected command (Sonnet round 1) in the lane's session (Recommended)
options.lose: You approve on the lane's account of the rounds, which triage cannot check.

options.gain: Nothing is filed that you doubt.
options.label: Do not approve: the record should differ
